That function replays already evolved fixed genes with train_ratio 0.70 and does not refit the prefilter/GA per fold. These are selection-used diagnostics, as typed artifact roles already state, not independent nested validation. TrialReturnsWriter receives only post-GA admitted quality-screen candidates; DSR N is that screen count and CSCV/PBO reranks the recorded cohort. Do not claim these statistics cover all adaptive GA/feature-selection trials. Existing autoresearch can re-deflate against a session count, but cannot reconstruct omitted paths.

Additional reproducible selection distortion: actual sparse Jaccard helper and exact production normalize/blend block executed in a CPU probe with canonical PropFirm v4, legacy Risky v5 and current Risky goal v6 objectives. Four identical feature-index signatures {0} with strong metrics, one {1} with weaker metrics, k=3; append one {0} zero-trade candidate (-100). At novelty=0.2 the weak candidate overtakes the strong only when the idle sentinel is present. All 12 mode x sentinel x novelty-control conditions pass. This proves population-dependent pressure distortion, not historical overfitting causation. Jaccard observes only feature-index sets, not weights, thresholds or trade behavior.

Source baseline edba75b on codex/ga-objective-convergence; mechanism probe .git/novelty-normalization-cpu-probe.rs/.log (intermediate only), docs/canonical-cpu-research.md updated with scope and ablation requirements. CASS/repo-map resume fails because machine-local .codex/continuity.json is absent; unavailable history is not empty history. Library searches found prior audits and unrelated independent baselines, no exact original GA run in the queried results. Do not rerun those baselines as if they were Neoethos.
acceptance_criteria: Retain verified mechanism evidence separately from financial outcomes. Inspect actual per-run effective config, candidate/fold/calibration summaries and data/cost identities when available. Use canonical CPU evaluation for paired seeds with the same frozen selection/calibration inputs, budget and costs, altering one suspect mechanism at a time; record actual evaluation slots, behavior diversity, all stage counts and calibration returns. A useful overfitting claim requires repeated unseen degradation, not merely a ranking inversion or passing unit tests. Never choose settings using the reserved final holdout, weaken gates to create survivors, or infer independence from internal WF/PBO/DSR labels. Any algorithm change must have its own focused regression and native semantic review; no GPU proof is available. Keep open until market-data attribution is established or explicitly bounded by unavailable inputs.
